description.en:
Starts a match: the match map (e.g. "mf02b11") and the battle ID (e.g. "btl0308", the match script). It prepares the match data (the battle ID), then schedules a jump to the match map. The place to come back to is the current map and the position and direction of the character the player controls.
The third argument is a flag stored with the match data when it is a boolean or an integer (the story events pass true; the challenge NPCs pass an empty table, which counts as false). With five arguments, the fourth (a map ID) and the fifth (an array [x, y, z, direction]) give another place to come back to.
Stored with the match data (true in story matches).
Map to come back to (with returnPos).
[x, y, z, direction] to come back to.

true once scheduled, false if the jump could not be scheduled.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.
